race.title: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
race.verdict: BEAU DE MAINE showed plenty - behind one who's since run well over hurdles - in a Market Rasen bumper on his debut last month, so he's an appealing candidate making a quick switch to jumping for a yard that continues in fine fettle. Popton Point won 2 of her 3 starts in the bumper sphere last season, impressing with her attitude, and is surely up to making her presence felt on her hurdling debut, while Uda Man Dan is an interesting newcomer given his useful Flat pedigree. BEAU DE MAINE (FR) POPTON POINT (IRE) UDA MAN DAN (GER)
